---
title: "NHANES CHD Explorer"
---

An interactive R Shiny companion to my [NHANES coronary heart disease project](https://github.com/Markholmezza/nhanes-chd), using 5,751 adults from CDC NHANES 2013–2014, 232 of whom reported coronary heart disease (CHD).

* **Outreach planner:** choose an outreach capacity or a risk cutoff and see the adults flagged, cases reached, PPV, and lift, computed from 5-fold out-of-fold predictions.
* **Population prevalence:** survey-weighted CHD prevalence with 95% CIs (R `survey`) for any subgroup.
* **Data quality checks:** eleven edit checks on the analysis file, with a drill-down to the flagged records.

NHANES is cross-sectional and CHD is a self-reported past diagnosis, so the outreach view illustrates a capacity-based decision framework, not a screening tool.

The app is hosted on shinyapps.io and may take a few seconds to wake up. You can also [open it in a new tab](https://ziang-zhang.shinyapps.io/nhanes-chd-explorer/){target="_blank"}.
